name: AI Builder
use_label: Build a site or app by describing it
one_liner: Describe what you want in plain words and AI builds the website or app in your browser, ready to publish.

text.why: Even a small calculator or sign-up page often means finding a developer or joining a paid builder. AI Builder is an open-source alternative to Lovable, Replit and v0: describe, edit and publish a site or app from the browser.
text.take: Most AI site builders are paid services; this one publishes the same workflow as Apache-2.0 source.
build: Built on Puter.js, which bundles authentication, storage, database, serverless functions and hosting. A live preview updates as you work; you can ask for changes in chat or click an element in the preview to change just that part, and restore earlier saved versions.

who.role: Small business owners, planners and students who want a simple site or tool without writing code.

start.text: Open builder.puter.com and type what you want to build, or start from one of the suggested ideas such as a quiz game or an expense tracker.

caveat: Apps you make run on Puter.js (Puter's auth, storage and hosting), so they depend on the Puter platform. The repository is new (117 stars).

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: The AI Builder start screen: a prompt box asking what to build, with idea buttons such as Quiz game, Pomodoro timer and Expense tracker.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
